title: second pass on the pixel banner — bigger wordmark in the TUI header
task_body: The first pixel banner shipped a small wordmark. The TUI header looks better with a roomier mark; rework the brand asset to a bigger pixel grid and update the TUI header to consume it.
rationale: Historically-failed retrieval case: brand/banner work is mostly asset + palette plumbing; filenames rarely match the natural-language description. banner.rs renders the wordmark/lockup; palette.rs provides the gradient; the TUI header consumes the renderer.
